4. What Management Did Right vs. Wrong & Earnings Call Q&A Audit

✅ What Management Did Right (Operational Tailwinds)

  • AI ACV Target Raised +70% YTD to $1.70B: Lifted year-end AI ACV target from $1.3B in Q2 to $1.70B as production autonomous agentic actions expanded more than 13x YoY.
  • Q3 Subscription & cRPO Outperformance: Subscription revenues of $3,988.0M (+20.89% YoY) beat the top end of prior guidance ($3,935M) by +$53.0M, while cRPO of $13.65B (+21.0% c/c) beat guide by +150 bps with 19 deals >$5M net new ACV.
  • FY26 FCF Margin Raised +100 bps to 36.0%: Combined 22.5% FY26 subscription revenue growth guidance ($15,785M midpoint) with 36.0% Non-GAAP FCF margin and 32.5% Q3 Non-GAAP operating margin.
  • Control Tower Alliance Ecosystem Moat: Secured deep agentic governance integrations with OpenAI (Action Fabric), NVIDIA (OpenShell), and AWS, cementing NOW as the enterprise control plane.

⚠️ What Management Did Wrong (Execution Headwinds & Sell-Off Catalysts)

  • Non-GAAP EPS Miss ($1.00 vs $1.02 Consensus): Higher tax rate adjustments and M&A integration expenses pushed Non-GAAP EPS to $1.00 (-1.96% miss) and GAAP EPS to $0.27 ($277.0M GAAP Net Income).
  • Q4 cRPO Growth Deceleration Guide (18.5% c/c): Guiding Q4 cRPO growth down 250 bps sequentially from 21.0% c/c in Q3 to 18.5% c/c rattled high-multiple growth investors.
  • Heavy Stock-Based Compensation & Dilution ($630.0M): Q3 SBC consumed 15.3% of revenue, while Q4 diluted share count is guided up to 1.05B shares despite $557.0M in Q3 buybacks.
  • M&A Cash Drain & GAAP Gross Margin Compression: Business combinations consumed $1,089.0M cash in Q3 ($4,043.0M YTD) and intangibles amortization ($210.0M total in Q3) weighed on GAAP operating margin (9.38%).
